register_map.notes: Pointer selects Temp, Conf, Thyst, or Tos; pointer register itself is not user-accessible.

read_channels.notes: 11 significant bits from Temp register; 5 LSBs of low byte are ignored.

raw_encoding.notes: Temp register returns 2 bytes; only 11 MSBs form a two's complement temperature value.

registers_or_commands.name: Temp
registers_or_commands.description: Temperature register; read only; two 8-bit data bytes; 11-bit 2's complement data.

registers_or_commands.name: Conf
registers_or_commands.description: Configuration Register; contains a single 8-bit data byte.

registers_or_commands.name: Tos
registers_or_commands.description: Over-temp Shutdown threshold Register; write/read; 9-bit 2's complement data.

registers_or_commands.name: pointer
registers_or_commands.description: Pointer register byte; two LSB bits select Temp, Conf, Thyst, or Tos.

bitfields.name: OS Fault queue
bitfields.description: Queue data = 0,1,2,3 for queue value = 1,2,4,6 respectively.

bitfields.name: OS Polarity
bitfields.description: 1 = OS active HIGH, 0 = OS active LOW.

init_sequence.notes: At power-up the device defaults to normal mode, OS comparator mode, Tos=80 °C, Thyst=75 °C, OS active LOW, and pointer value = 0.
No explicit bus traffic is required before the first temperature read because the Temp register is selected by default.
Wait about 100 ms after power-up before expecting valid temperature data.

read_sequence.notes: Read temperature by setting pointer to Temp (0x00), then reading 2 bytes (MS then LS).
Combine the 2 bytes as a signed 16-bit raw value; use only the 11 MSBs and ignore the 5 LSBs of the low byte.

timing_constraints.name: temperature_conversion_period
timing_constraints.notes: temp-to-digital conversion is executed every 100 ms

timing_constraints.name: first_valid_temp_wait
timing_constraints.notes: The temp reading data is not available until the first conversion is completed in about 100 ms.

timing_constraints.name: scl_high_pulse_width_min
timing_constraints.notes: t HIGH   | SCL HIGH pulse width

timing_constraints.name: scl_low_pulse_width_min
timing_constraints.notes: t LOW    | SCL LOW pulse width

timing_constraints.name: fall_time_typ
timing_constraints.condition: I2C bus timing, C L = 400 pF; I OL = 3 mA
timing_constraints.notes: t F      | Fall time (SDA and OS outputs)

conversion_formulae.name: temperature_from_temp_raw
conversion_formulae.formula: Temp in degC is the signed 11-bit 2's complement temperature value multiplied by 0.125 °C/LSB.

inputs.name: raw_signed_11
inputs.description: 16-bit Temp register; use only bits D10..D0 after dropping the 5 LSBs of the low byte.

conversion_formulae.name: setpoint_from_tos_raw
conversion_formulae.formula: Tos in degC is the signed 9-bit 2's complement set-point value multiplied by 0.5 °C/LSB.

inputs.name: raw_signed_9
inputs.description: 16-bit Tos register; use only bits D8..D0 after dropping the 7 LSBs of the low byte.

conversion_formulae.name: setpoint_from_thyst_raw
conversion_formulae.formula: Thyst in degC is the signed 9-bit 2's complement set-point value multiplied by 0.5 °C/LSB.

inputs.name: raw_signed_9
inputs.description: 16-bit Thyst register; use only bits D8..D0 after dropping the 7 LSBs of the low byte.

error_conditions.detection: Slave does not acknowledge address byte during a bus transaction.
Slave does not acknowledge a data byte during write or read transfer.
Programmed Tos is less than or equal to Thyst after conversion to physical units.
Bits B7-B5 of Conf are set to a nonzero value by software.
error_conditions.driver_action: mask to documented bits or reject write; return -EINVAL if strict validation is enabled

power_states.name: normal
power_states.description: Periodic temperature conversion is active every 100 ms; I2C interface remains active.

power_states.name: shut_down
power_states.description: Conversion stops, temperature register holds latest result, I2C interface remains active; OS resets in interrupt mode.

evidence_spans.snippet: These pins represent the three LSB bits of the device 7-bit address. The other four MSB bits of the address data are preset to '1001'
At power-up, the Pointer value is equal to 0 and the Temp register is selected
only 11 significant bits should be used, and the 5 LSB bits of the LS byte are zero and should be ignored.
However, only 9 bits of the two bytes are used to store the set-point data in 2's complement format with the resolution of 0.5 ° C.
